{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Number of unique patient_id: {df["patient_id"].nunique()}')
print(f'Total rows: {len(df)}')
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df["biomarker_baseline"].eq(-999).sum()}')

# Check assay_batch values
print(f'Unique assay_batch values: {df["assay_batch"].unique()}')

# Check for sample_seq > 1 (indicating re-test)
print(f'Number of patients with sample_seq > 1: {df["patient_id"].duplicated(keep=False).sum()}')

# Check arm distribution by severity
print('\nArm distribution by severity:')
print(df.groupby(['arm', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))"}
